meta.rule: one interior point per building of a checked research site (campus-site-join: public site layout and, where read, land-office parcels); a site is a group of buildings for the map, not a title deed, the deed area or ownership
meta.published: interior points, building count, source, public layout link, check date; the boundary, deed numbers, parcel data and notes stay in the research sheet
meta.status: sites from rows staged for the research site tab (sites/site_rows.csv), not yet written to the tab
